Hello everyone this Sunday we are starting our new schedule moving forward from
crowd to community. (see last week's post for schedule)

 

Last week we had a minor bump with many people being sick and a way. This week
we're gonna pick up and continue in our journey.

 

1- Please bring your workbooks. I will be updating from version 1.0 to 1.2 this
Sunday.

2- This week we start our accountability in our life groups. I hope you have all
been completing the work. Looking forward to the stories.

3- For guests joining life group; they need to register before Friday. They will
be part of life group C- "Come and Follow Jesus". 9AM to 950AM.

4- For guests not joining us for life group gathering starts at 11 AM. 

5- Worship leaders and teams. I was going to lead worship last Sunday, but then
I got very sick. It is unlikely that I'm well enough to lead worship this coming
Sunday.  It would be great if others can step in for us to have at least twice a
month live worship.

 

Blessings,

Jorge
